name: io.github.andreasjhagen/computer-controller
description: MCP server for desktop automation: launch apps, capture screenshots, control mouse and keyboard

environmentVariables.name: DISPLAY_INDEX
environmentVariables.description: Fix all tools to one monitor: 0 or unset = no restriction (tools start on the primary and follow the last display passed), 1 = primary monitor, 2 = second monitor.

environmentVariables.name: WIDTH
environmentVariables.description: Optional maximum screenshot width in pixels. Images retain aspect ratio and are not padded.

environmentVariables.name: HEIGHT
environmentVariables.description: Optional maximum screenshot height in pixels. Images retain aspect ratio and are not padded.
